nodes.description: Private owner address inherited from Ownable, controls all onlyOwner privileged functions.
Mapping of account balances, debited and credited inside _transfer and _mint.
Nested allowance mapping written by _approve and consumed by transferFrom.
Total token supply, increased by _mint and decreased by _burn.
Owner-controlled blacklist mapping checked on every transfer recipient.
Token decimals set to 18 in the ERC20 constructor.
onlyOwner function that adds or removes an address from the antiBotList blacklist.
Internal _transfer: validates addresses, enforces the antiBotList, and moves balances with SafeMath.
Public transfer forwarding _msgSender() to the internal _transfer.
Public transferFrom moving sender funds and decrementing the caller allowance.
onlyOwner mint entry point that credits _msgSender() with new tokens.
Internal _mint increasing total supply and recipient balance.
Public approve granting allowance from _msgSender() to a spender.
Internal _approve writing the allowance mapping and emitting Approval.
Atomically increases the caller allowance using SafeMath add.
Atomically decreases the caller allowance using SafeMath sub.
BohemianBulldogs constructor that mints the initial supply of 1e15*1e18 tokens.
onlyOwner function setting _owner to address(0).
onlyOwner function transferring ownership to newOwner.
msg.sender accessed through _msgSender(); attacker-controlled caller of every public function.
Owner-restricted write antiBotList[addr] = isAdd that silently blacklists recipients.
SafeMath sub/add pair on _balances inside _transfer.
SafeMath sub on _allowances[sender][_msgSender()] inside transferFrom.
SafeMath add operations on _totalSupply and _balances inside _mint.
addr parameter of addOrRemoveFromBotList used as key into antiBotList.
isAdd boolean parameter of addOrRemoveFromBotList setting the blacklist value.
sender address parameter of _transfer whose balance is debited.
recipient address parameter of _transfer checked against the antiBotList.
amount parameter of _transfer used in SafeMath balance arithmetic.
spender parameter of _approve used as key into _allowances.
addedValue parameter of increaseAllowance added to the allowance.
subtractedValue parameter of decreaseAllowance subtracted from the allowance.
newOwner parameter of transferOwnership assigned to _owner.
account parameter of _mint receiving the new balance.
amount parameter of mint credited to msg.sender.

edges.reason: msg.sender is validated by the onlyOwner modifier before addOrRemoveFromBotList executes.
addOrRemoveFromBotList performs the owner-restricted blacklist write.
The blacklist write mutates the antiBotList state variable.
_transfer reads antiBotList[recipient] and reverts for blacklisted addresses.
_transfer computes the new balances through SafeMath sub and add.
The balance arithmetic result is stored into the _balances mapping.
transfer delegates its logic to the internal _transfer.
transferFrom delegates the balance movement to the internal _transfer.
transferFrom decreases the spender allowance with SafeMath sub.
The allowance arithmetic updates the _allowances mapping.
mint delegates token creation to the internal _mint.
mint is owner-restricted and mints to the untrusted msg.sender.
_mint performs SafeMath additions on total supply and balance.
Mint arithmetic increases the _totalSupply state variable.
Mint arithmetic increases the recipient entry in _balances.
The constructor mints the fixed initial supply through _mint.
approve delegates the allowance update to _approve.
_approve writes the allowance into the _allowances mapping.
increaseAllowance adds addedValue to _allowances with SafeMath.
decreaseAllowance subtracts subtractedValue from _allowances with SafeMath.
transfer uses _msgSender() as the untrusted sender of funds.
approve uses _msgSender() as the untrusted allowance owner.
transferFrom uses _msgSender() as the untrusted spender of the allowance.
onlyOwner on transferOwnership compares msg.sender with _owner.
transferOwnership reassigns the _owner state variable after the owner check.
renounceOwnership sets _owner to address(0) after the onlyOwner check.
addr parameter determines which address is added to or removed from antiBotList.
isAdd parameter decides the blacklist membership value.
sender parameter identifies the balance debited in _transfer.
recipient parameter is checked against antiBotList before crediting.
amount parameter feeds the SafeMath balance operations in _transfer.
spender parameter is the key written into _allowances by _approve.
addedValue parameter is added to the caller allowance.
subtractedValue parameter is subtracted from the caller allowance.
newOwner parameter becomes the new _owner value.
account parameter receives the minted balance in _mint.
amount parameter of mint is credited to the owner balance.

normalization_plan.reason: addr exists only to key the antiBotList write performed by addOrRemoveFromBotList.
isAdd exists only to set the blacklist value inside addOrRemoveFromBotList.
sender parameter is only meaningful as the debited account of _transfer.
recipient parameter is only meaningful as the credited and blacklist-checked account of _transfer.
amount parameter is only used by the balance arithmetic of _transfer.
spender parameter exists solely as the allowance key written by _approve.
addedValue is only consumed by the allowance addition in increaseAllowance.
subtractedValue is only consumed by the allowance subtraction in decreaseAllowance.
newOwner parameter exists only to be assigned to _owner in transferOwnership.
account parameter exists only to receive the balance credited by _mint.
amount parameter of mint is only used to credit the owner through _mint.
